review_type: Targeted primary-source related-work review; not exhaustive systematic review or reproduced benchmark
retrieval: Agent Reach Exa search/fetch, with version-specific Context7 documentation cross-check

sources.title: SKAB author repository, pinned snapshot
sources.reviewed: Dataset description and Proposed Leaderboard protocol
sources.supported_claim: Outlier/changepoint metrics and the right-sided 60-second NAB window differ from SignalWatch onset_v2.
sources.limit: Pinned historical documentation; not a claim about current testbed availability. External scores were not reproduced.

sources.title: Towards a Rigorous Evaluation of Time-Series Anomaly Detection
sources.reviewed: Abstract and introduction explaining point adjustment
sources.supported_claim: Point adjustment can inflate apparent performance and obscure score differences.
sources.limit: Our historical overlap-credit bug is related in reporting risk, not identical to the paper's PA implementation.

sources.title: Volume Under the Surface: A New Accuracy Evaluation Measure for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
sources.supported_claim: Range-aware threshold-independent metrics address evaluation sensitivity to noise and temporal misalignment.
sources.limit: VUS was not calculated here and does not measure an operational false-episode budget. No figures or code copied.

sources.title: The Elephant in the Room: Towards A Reliable Time-Series Anomaly Detection Benchmark
sources.supported_claim: Separate tuning/evaluation collections, dataset checks and multiple metrics support fair comparisons; threshold setting is separate from its ranking focus.
sources.limit: Different data, supervision and metric conventions; no TSB-AD implementation was run or numerical superiority claimed.

sources.title: An on-line framework for monitoring nonlinear processes with multiple operating modes
sources.authors: Ruomu Tan, Tian Cong, James R. Ottewill, Jerzy Baranowski and Nina F. Thornhill
sources.reviewed: Introduction, selected monitoring-method discussion and section 5 expert-confirmed mode update
sources.supported_claim: Unrepresented healthy modes can resemble anomalies; confirmed healthy-mode updates differ from automatic learning on every alarm.
sources.limit: DP-GMM/NSDC-KPCA is not our diagonal GMM-HGB pipeline; no published gains reproduced or physical causes inferred.

sources.title: CANDI: Curated Test-Time Adaptation for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
sources.supported_claim: The proposed test-time adaptation curates potential false-positive samples using scores and latent similarity.
sources.limit: Abstract-level comparison only; no full-method validation. V10 offline labelled-normal weighting is a different mechanism.

sources.title: Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty? Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift
sources.reviewed: Abstract, introduction and selected uncertainty-under-shift discussion
sources.supported_claim: Post-hoc confidence calibration has limits under dataset shift.
sources.limit: Classification study rather than pump telemetry; it does not prove the cause of SignalWatch's V7 regression.

sources.title: Sequential Multivariate Change Detection with Calibrated and Memoryless False Detection Rates
sources.authors: Oliver Cobb, Arnaud Van Looveren and Janis Klaise
sources.reviewed: Abstract and sections 2.1-2.2/3.1 on assumptions, expected runtime and correlated test outcomes
sources.supported_claim: Expected no-change runtime and time-conditional false-detection probabilities need explicit calibration.
sources.limit: Independent stream and i.i.d. reference assumptions do not directly cover dependent sensor observations, gaps or our episode resets.

sources.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
sources.authors: Gavin C. Cawley and Nicola L. C. Talbot
sources.supported_claim: Optimization of finite-sample validation criteria can overfit model selection.
sources.limit: No estimated magnitude or causal attribution of selection bias in SignalWatch.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH handbook: EWMA Control Charts
sources.reviewed: Statistic, gradual-shift sensitivity, reference-data and independence/normality assumptions
sources.supported_claim: Historical evidence accumulation can detect small or gradual shifts.
sources.limit: Statistical comparator, not a trained ML replacement; standard limits need justified assumptions for dependent telemetry.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH handbook: CUSUM Control Charts
sources.reviewed: Small-mean-shift sensitivity, cumulative statistic and design-parameter discussion
sources.supported_claim: Accumulating deviations differs from requiring persistence after a threshold crossing.
sources.limit: No CUSUM implementation, threshold calibration or detection gain was measured here.

sources.title: scikit-learn 1.9.1 preprocessing and leakage guidance
sources.reviewed: Scaling, robust alternatives, train-only transforms; Context7 1.9.1 cross-check
sources.supported_claim: Training-only preprocessing and scale inspection are necessary; scaler choice depends on distribution.
sources.limit: Does not prescribe our 1e-6 zero-IQR floor or prove that one alternative will improve alarm quality.

sources.title: scikit-learn 1.9.1 diagonal Gaussian-mixture implementation
sources.reviewed: Diagonal covariance and expanded log-Gaussian arithmetic, matching prior installed-source audit
sources.supported_claim: Second-moment subtraction and expanded quadratics can lose precision under our extreme V12 input scaling.
sources.limit: Fixed-parameter numerical evidence does not quantify complete EM error or prove the cause of all K4 alarms; no library code modified.
